_comment: Purchasable/usable items. Effect kinds: 'restrain_hit' caps a single hit's damage against a wild creature at cap_ratio * its max HP, for the rest of the current battle -- it does not stop a creature from being finished off over several hits, only from being ended in one. See docs/DESIGN.md section 13.

items.name: Tempering Draught
items.description: Steadies the hand. For the rest of this fight, no single blow you land can end it outright.
